name: Maged S. Al-Shaibani
role: NLP Researcher · AI Engineer at the SDAIA–KFUPM Joint Research Center for AI
bio: I am an NLP researcher and AI engineer at the [SDAIA–KFUPM Joint Research Center for Artificial Intelligence (JRCAI)](https://ri.kfupm.edu.sa/jrcai), [King Fahd University of Petroleum & Minerals (KFUPM)](https://www.kfupm.edu.sa). My research explores efficient text representation for language modeling, spanning tokenization, modeling, and the evaluation and tuning of multilingual LLMs. My work has appeared at ACL, EMNLP, and EACL, and in journals such as *Computational Linguistics*. I find it exciting to pursue research and translate it into open, reusable artifacts, such as datasets, models, and software packages, that others can build on. I co-founded ARBML, an open-source community for Arabic NLP, and maintain packages such as farasapy and tnqeet. I have contributed to large collaborative efforts, including BigScience (BLOOM and PromptSource), and I co-organize shared tasks in the community. Above all, I aim to contribute to the broader advancement of science, where progress depends as much on sharing ideas, data, and tools as on discovering them.
